description: 1.3: reading the real Brymen BM869s through its BU-86X USB cable (local plugin plugins/brymen): list the cables, open the first one, send the meter's request and read its packet, close it. Only the BU-86X (USB 0820:0001) is ever listed or opened; the page never chooses a device or a path. Desktop: hidapi; Android: android.hardware.usb with the system's permission dialog.
